# box-nodes seed — 占位节点，用于验证管线；替换成你自己的订阅链接后即可产出真实节点
# 支持逐行：vmess:// vless:// trojan:// ss:// ssr:// hysteria2:// tuic://
# 也支持整段 base64 订阅体直接粘贴进来

vmess:
vless://11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555@1.1.1.1:443?encryption=none&security=tls&sni=example.com&type=ws&host=example.com&path=%2Fws#SEED-VLESS
trojan://placeholder-password@example.com:443?sni=example.com&type=tcp#SEED-TROJAN
ss://YWVzLTI1Ni1nY206cGxhY2Vob2xkZXItcGFzc3dvcmQ=@8.8.8.8:443#SEED-SS
